sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 150 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 3 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 200% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Target: yourself. Applies Crimson King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases all stats for all allies by 50%. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Increases max Unison gauge capacity by 20 when equipped in the main slot.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 50.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +500

Shanchira, Heavenly General or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
